messages:
oliver: Heads up 0: Hardware+Model partner (FalconWorks) sent a draft that'd let us redistribute quantized weights under a 'no downstream relicensing' clause. They want joint announcement + AWS Marketplace listing. Thoughts?

nina: We should verify whether their quantized weights include any vendor-specific kernels. If so, export control might apply. @legal-squad can you check?

courtney: From PM side: FalconWorks wants Redwood to provide a 'Redwood-optimized' bundle with our kernels and an A/B suggestion for customers (cpu fallback vs tpu). They also want a co-branded solution brief.

legal-squad: Initial read: "no downstream relicensing" is acceptable, but ambiguous about "redistribution" to Marketplace customers. Need explicit grant: the partner must license Redwood to distribute the bundled artifacts to end customers via cloud marketplaces and private images. Also require a warranty/disclaimer for third-party kernel compatibility.

infra-bot: Note: AWS Marketplace requires a manifest with immutable license URL and checksums, and that the distributor holds redistribution rights. Also binary scanning required.

oliver: Proposed artifact naming: falconworks-falconx-v{ver}-platform-{quant}.tar.gz plus manifest.json with fields: model, version, quant_profile, license_url, sha256, supported_accels. Example manifest snippet included in the doc.

nina: For SI partners, we should offer a 2-week integration sprint and a detailed checklist: driver versions, kernel ABI, allowed syscalls, and fallback config. Courtney can we add this to the co-marketing deck?

courtney: Yes. Marketing asks to lock announcement date 2026-05-18. Legal and Eng signoff needed by 2026-05-04.

legal-squad: We'll draft a short addendum granting Redwood redistribution rights for specific marketplaces and on-prem packaging. Also include indemnity carveouts for modifications. Need partner to confirm export classification of compiled kernels.

oliver: Engineering estimate: 10 dev days to make the packaging pipeline + CI to produce signed bundles and a staging upload for security scan. Need one eng + one SRE.

infra-bot: Also flag: Marketplace listings can't contain keys or proprietary drivers. Ensure the bundle includes only runtime binaries and pointers to vendor drivers.

nina: Good point. We'll ask FalconWorks to provide an installer that fetches vendor drivers separately. Keeps bundle clean.

marketplace-bot: Created listing: falconworks-fx-marketplace-1850127890. Please attach docs and manifest when ready.

oliver: Action items: (1) @legal-squad draft redistribution addendum, (2) @nina request export classification + immutable license URL from partner, (3) @courtney prepare co-branded brief and lock dates, (4) engineering to start packaging PoC next week.

nina: I'll ping them now for the license permalink and export info.

oliver: Cool. We'll huddle on Fri for a quick run-through.
